name: 44314 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44314 (Akron) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44314 (Akron) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44314 (Akron) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
